newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn offers down, soy mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn offers down, soy mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn offers dropped in the nearby positions while soybean values were mostly unchanged on Monday amid lackluster activity, dealers said.
Dealers also noted scarce farm sales in corn and soybeans.

On the export front, Egypt's main grains buyer said on Monday he was informed by officials at the health ministry that wheat imports were excluded "for the time being" from a decree requiring proof that grain imports have not been genetically altered.
He also said he was seeking 50,000 tonnes of wheat.

Samir el-Shakankiri told Reuters he had been informed of the decision a few hours ago and that he wanted to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. or French wheat for delivery in August as soon as possible. The deadline for bids is 0730 GMT on July 22.
Soft red winter and hard red winter wheat values were steady.
